samples.gvd:
module multi_8bit (
    input [7:0] A,
    input [7:0] B,
    output reg [15:0] product
);

    integer i;

    always @(*) begin
        product = 16'b0; // Initialize product to zero
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
            if (B[i]) begin
                product = product + (A << i);
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="multi_8bit">
    <description>Implement a module of an 8-bit multiplier based on shifting and adding operations.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="A">First 8-bit input operand (representing a multiplicand).</input>
        <input id="B">Second 8-bit input operand (representing a multiplier).</input>
        <output id="product">16-bit output representing the product of the two 8-bit inputs (A * B).</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Multiplication: The module performs multiplication of A and B using the shift-and-add method.
- The algorithm iterates through each bit of the multiplier (B). For each bit that is set (1), the multiplicand (A) is added to the product at the corresponding shifted position.
- The process continues until all bits of the multiplier have been processed.
Shifting: After each addition, the multiplicand is logically shifted left by one bit to prepare for the next addition, simulating the traditional multiplication process.
The final product is stored in the output port, which is 16 bits wide to accommodate the maximum possible product of two 8-bit numbers.
    </implementation>
</module>
